verdict.rationale: OpenTofu's `tofu plan` explicitly supports a refresh-only mode that updates state to reflect out-of-band changes without applying corrections, which is the canonical drift-detection workflow, and a hands-on probe confirms plan surfaces detected changes via -detailed-exitcode in a real run. Missing for 10: an explicit end-to-end hands-on test showing detection of an externally-modified resource (drift) specifically, and independent/community validation of drift detection accuracy.
